description: Anatomical joint limits per bone. Each value is [min, max] in degrees of the pose rotation (the rest-relative local quaternion of poses/*.json) decomposed as three.js Euler order 'XYZ' (R = Rx * Ry * Rz) in the bone's own rest frame (rig/README.md). Limits are relative to the rest A-pose, not to the anatomical neutral position: the rest pose already has elbow flexion ~30 deg, knee flexion ~8 deg and shoulder abduction ~37-39 deg from vertical, which is subtracted below. Right-side entries are the left entries mirrored (x unchanged, y and z negated and swapped); rig/tools/check_limits.py verifies this. Values follow typical adult active ranges (AAOS / Kapandji), split over the spine, neck and head bones; the root (pelvis) carries whole-body orientation and is unlimited.

spine_01.note: x+ flexion (bend forward), y+ turn to the character's left, z+ lateral bend to the character's right

neck_01.note: x+ flexion (chin down), x- extension (look up), y+ turn left, z+ tilt to the right

clavicle_l.note: x+ protraction, x- retraction, y axial rotation, z+ elevation, z- depression

upperarm_l.note: x+ flexion (swing forward, about the rest elbow-bend axis), y+ internal rotation, y- external rotation, z+ abduction (raise sideways), z- adduction

lowerarm_l.note: x+ elbow flexion (rest is already ~30 deg flexed, so x = -30 is straight), y+ pronation, y- supination, z carrying-angle tolerance

hand_l.note: x+ wrist flexion (towards the palm), x- extension, z+ radial deviation (towards the thumb), z- ulnar deviation

thumb_01_l.note: carpometacarpal; x+ flexion across the palm (approximate axes)

index_01_l.note: MCP; x+ flexion (curl), z+ towards the thumb side

thigh_l.note: x- hip flexion (leg forward), x+ extension, y+ internal rotation, y- external rotation, z- abduction, z+ adduction

calf_l.note: x+ knee flexion (rest is ~8 deg flexed, so x = -8 is straight), y small tibial rotation

foot_l.note: x+ plantarflexion (point the foot), x- dorsiflexion, y- inversion, y+ eversion, z+ adduction (toes inward), z- abduction

ball_l.note: metatarsophalangeal; x+ toe flexion (curl down), x- extension (tiptoe)

upperarm_r.note: mirror of upperarm_l: y- internal rotation, z- abduction

hand_r.note: mirror of hand_l: z- radial deviation

thigh_r.note: mirror of thigh_l: y- internal rotation, z+ abduction

foot_r.note: mirror of foot_l: y+ inversion, z- adduction
